decisions.reason: Moving navigation links to the website footer does not change the established dark theme for shared website pages.
The same source message already establishes that the header menu is disabled; placing links in the separate footer Requirement requires no additional change here.
This Requirement concerns the admin workspace shell, including its own footer, while the source decision concerns navigation links in the public website footer.
Footer navigation placement does not alter the required color, typography, spacing, radii, or border token specifications.
The footer navigation decision does not change the landing page's established section order or How It Works content.
Enabling navigation links in the footer does not modify the approved responsive breakpoint guidance.
The navigation-link placement decision does not change the landing page's plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
The source message separately discusses missing LumenArc branding, but the footer navigation decision does not change that branding Requirement.
Adding links to the footer does not change the requirement that the landing page support responsive layouts.
The footer navigation decision does not alter the landing page's required sign-up call to action.
Footer link placement does not change the landing page's selected visual concepts, colors, theme, typography, or unresolved logo treatment.
The footer navigation decision does not affect how text is emphasized in the landing page hero.
